quarterly_data.quarter: Doosan Fuel Cell press release: EQUIS CONSORTIUM COMMENCES COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS OF KOREA'S (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Release on Doosan Fuel Cell's newsroom: Equis commenced commercial operations (reached in March 2026, on schedule) of a 40 MW hydrogen fuel cell power project in Uijeongbu, Korea - Korea's largest fuel cell plant under the Hydrogen Portfolio Standards - deploying 90 Doosan Fuel Cell PureCell Model 400 PAFC units, generating approximately 300 GWh a year and selling 100% of its electricity to KEPCO under a 20-year offtake agreement.
quarterly_data.figure: 90 PureCell Model 400 units; 40 MW; approximately 300 GWh per year
